items.title: Quest Global appoints Krish Kupathil to support internal AI initiatives and client collaboration
items.excerpt: Quest Global appointed Krish Kupathil to lead internal and client-facing AI strategy, including work with customers on AI-enabled engineering solutions and translating engineering challenges into measurable adoption outcomes.
items.query: site:questglobal.com/news/press-releases/ September 2026 Quest Global aerospace AI engineering

items.title: GE Aerospace Advances XA102 Adaptive Cycle Engine Assembly for U.S. Air Force’s Next Generation Adaptive Propulsion Program
items.excerpt: GE Aerospace is moving the XA102 adaptive-cycle engine toward first test-asset assembly. The program uses model-based engineering to reduce development time and cost while suppliers procure hardware and subcomponents for assembly and test.
items.query: site:geaerospace.com/news September 2026 GE Aerospace technology engine digital engineering

items.title: GE Aerospace confident GE9X mid-seal issue will not delay Boeing 777X entry into service
items.excerpt: Reuters reports GE identified the GE9X mid-seal durability root cause in April, redesigned the part, and began shipping the improved seal to Boeing in Q3 2026. GE says internal testing validated the redesign and separate FAA certification is underway.
items.query: "GE Aerospace" September 2026 engine technology manufacturing MRO

items.title: Rolls-Royce to elevate EU’s latest Clean Aviation call
items.excerpt: Rolls-Royce was selected to lead the EU Clean Aviation ELEVATED project to demonstrate a hybrid-electric gas-turbine propulsion system for future short- to medium-range aircraft, and will also participate in FARMAN and H-ELENA hydrogen-related projects.

items.title: RTX's Pratt & Whitney completes F135 Engine Core Upgrade Risk Reduction Design Review
items.excerpt: Pratt & Whitney completed the F135 Engine Core Upgrade Risk Reduction Design Review. The review covered detailed design maturity, propulsion technologies, aircraft integration, test preparation and industrial-base readiness for production and retrofit.
items.query: site:rtx.com/news/news-center/2026/09 Pratt Whitney September 2026 engine technology

items.title: Airlines urge more competition on used jet engine parts
items.excerpt: Reuters reports IATA is pushing for broader competition in used engine parts after a European Commission settlement involving Pratt & Whitney Canada eased restrictions on used parts for turboprop engines. The issue directly affects engine MRO availability and aftermarket economics.
items.query: "Pratt & Whitney" September 2026 engine MRO used parts competition

items.title: La DGA commande des premiers travaux en amont du prochain lancement en réalisation du standard F5 du Rafale, prévu fin 2026
items.excerpt: France's DGA awarded Safran Aircraft Engines preliminary-design work for the M88 T-REX. The upgrade targets 20% more maximum thrust, from 7.5 to 9 tonnes, while retaining M88-2 modular architecture and modifying selected engine modules.

items.title: Wolfgang-Heilmann-Preis der MTU Aero Engines geht an Jonas Beil
items.excerpt: MTU highlighted a KIT master's thesis on a turbine concept for extracting power from a rotating detonation combustor. The work addresses rotating-detonation gas-turbine architecture and turbine integration, making it a current propulsion-research signal.
items.query: site:mtu.de/newsroom September 2026 MTU Aero Engines technology turbine
items.organization: MTU Aero Engines / Karlsruhe Institute of Technology

items.title: CFM International and Vietjet expand strategic partnership to explore MRO capabilities for latest-generation engines in Vietnam
items.excerpt: CFM and Vietjet signed an LOI to assess a local LEAP engine MRO capability in Vietnam. CFM would advise on maintenance requirements, infrastructure, workforce and industry considerations for a potential airline-operated maintenance solution.
items.query: site:cfmaeroengines.com/press-articles September 2026 CFM MRO LEAP Vietnam

items.title: SimScale Launches Engineering AI Agent for Onshape
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: SimScale launched an Engineering AI Agent inside Onshape that can reason through CFD, thermal, electromagnetics and FEA setup from CAD geometry, run simulations and interpret results. This direct CAD-to-simulation agent workflow warrants continued watchlist monitoring.
items.query: site:simscale.com September 2026 engineering AI simulation agent

items.title: Building Beyond CAD: On Generative Optimization for Engineering
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: PhysicsX describes adapting 3D foundation models to engineering geometry, coupling generated shapes to numerical simulation and optimization, and reports a SimJEB bracket result 18.5% lighter than the prior winner while meeting the stress constraint. Strong fit for AI-native design monitoring.
